title: Information-Theoretic Analysis of Multi-Objective Bandits: Pareto Violations & Gap-Based Regret
abstract: arXiv:2611.29808v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study Bayesian multi-objective bandits and ask an information-theoretic question: what aspects of an unknown environment must be resolved to achieve low regret? We show that the answer depends on the regret criterion and the information needed to represent its loss. For Pareto-violation regret, which incurs unit loss whenever a dominated action is selected, the Pareto-optimal set is a natural information target. We introduce a predictive separation measure for competing candidate Pareto sets, connect it to information gain about the unknown set, and use this connection to analyze Thompson Sampling and develop an Information-Directed Sampling strategy. We establish sublinear Bayesian regret under uniform and polynomially decaying separation and prove a lower bound showing that weak separation can impose an unavoidable statistical cost. We then study gap-based Pareto regret, which quantifies the magnitude of Pareto suboptimality. Here,

translated_title: 多目标老虎机问题的信息论分析：帕累托违反与基于间隙的遗憾
translated_abstract: 我们研究贝叶斯多目标老虎机问题，并提出一个信息论问题：为了实现低遗憾，未知环境的哪些方面必须被弄清楚？我们表明，答案取决于遗憾准则以及表示其损失所需的信息。对于帕累托违反遗憾（每当选择被支配的动作时就会产生单位损失），帕累托最优集是一个自然的信息目标。我们为相互竞争的候选帕累托集引入了一种预测分离度量，将其与关于未知集的信息增益联系起来，并利用这一联系分析汤普森采样并开发了一种信息导向采样策略。我们在均匀分离和多项式衰减分离的条件下建立了次线性贝叶斯遗憾界，并证明了下界，表明弱分离会带来不可避免的统计代价。随后，我们研究了基于间隙的帕累托遗憾，它量化了帕累托次优性的幅度。
tldr: 本文从信息论角度分析贝叶斯多目标老虎机，针对帕累托违反遗憾引入预测分离度量并将其与信息增益联系，据此提出信息导向采样策略，给出了次线性遗憾上界和揭示弱分离代价的下界。
en_tdlr: This paper provides an information-theoretic analysis of Bayesian multi-objective bandits, introducing a predictive separation measure tied to information gain about the Pareto-optimal set, developing an Information-Directed Sampling strategy with sublinear regret guarantees, and proving lower bounds showing the unavoidable cost of weak separation.
